verdict.rationale: The docs describe a very short path to a working skill. You create a single `SKILL.md` and Claude adds it to its toolkit, then invoke it directly with `/skill-name`. A template SKILL.md and a skill-creator skill are available, and installing official example skills takes two commands (`/plugin marketplace add anthropics/skills`, then `/plugin install`). missing for 10: an explicit step-by-step quickstart page with a stated time-to-first-skill, and independent or hands-on confirmation that a newcomer reaches a working installed skill in under five minutes.
